title: Moira — Subscription Utilization
description: How much of each LLM subscription is used before it resets, and how many requests Moira routes to each model. Source: moira-poller (moira_quota_used_pct, used % per provider window, polled every 5 min) and Moira's /decide counters (moira_decide_total, moira_refusals_total). Used % only rises within a window, so the reading right before a drop is that window's final utilization; 100 minus it expired unused.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider, window, value FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['provider'] AS provider, Attributes['window'] AS window, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'moira_quota_used_pct' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['window'] IN (${window:singlequote}), $window)
  GROUP BY Attributes, provider, window
) ORDER BY provider, window

panels.title: Expired unused at last reset
panels.description: 100 minus the reading just before each window's most recent reset in the range. Windows that have not reset in the range are absent.

targets.rawSql:
WITH series AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, Attributes['provider'] AS provider, Attributes['window'] AS window, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'moira_quota_used_pct' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['window'] IN (${window:singlequote}), $window)
  GROUP BY t, Attributes, provider, window
), lagged AS (
  SELECT t, provider, window, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY provider, window ORDER BY t) AS prev_v FROM series
), resets AS (
  SELECT provider, window, argMax(prev_v, t) AS last_prev FROM lagged WHERE v < prev_v - 5 GROUP BY provider, window
)
SELECT provider, window, 100 - last_prev AS value FROM resets ORDER BY provider, window

SELECT time, series, value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['provider'], ' ', Attributes['window']) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'moira_quota_used_pct' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['window'] IN (${window:singlequote}), $window)
  GROUP BY time, Attributes, Attributes['provider'], Attributes['window']
) ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Expired unused per reset
panels.description: One point per window reset: % of that window left unused.

targets.rawSql:
WITH series AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, Attributes['provider'] AS provider, Attributes['window'] AS window, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'moira_quota_used_pct' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['window'] IN (${window:singlequote}), $window)
  GROUP BY t, Attributes, provider, window
), lagged AS (
  SELECT t, provider, window, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY provider, window ORDER BY t) AS prev_v FROM series
)
SELECT t AS time, concat(provider, ' ', window) AS series, 100 - prev_v AS value FROM lagged WHERE v < prev_v - 5 ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Requests per model
panels.description: Requests Moira routed to each model in the selected time range. Counts Moira's choice; when a LiteLLM fallback serves instead, LiteLLM_SpendLogs.model_group differs (join on moira.decision.request_id = metadata->>'litellm_call_id').

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model, sum(d) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['model'] AS model, d, TimeUnix FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'moira_decide_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime GROUP BY model HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Requests per tier and model
panels.description: Requested name (moira/<tier> or a router/* group) and the model Moira routed it to, over the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT requested, model, sum(d) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['requested'] AS requested, Attributes['model'] AS model, d, TimeUnix FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'moira_decide_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime GROUP BY requested, model HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Requests per model per hour
panels.description: Requests Moira routed to each model, one bar per hour.

targets.rawSql:
WITH increments AS (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['model'] AS model, sum(d) AS d FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'moira_decide_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY time, model
), timeline AS (SELECT toStartOfInterval($__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) + toIntervalSecond(number * greatest($__interval_s, 60)) AS time FROM numbers(toUInt64(greatest(dateDiff('second', toStartOfInterval($__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND), $__toTime), 0) / greatest($__interval_s, 60)) + 1)), labels AS (SELECT DISTINCT model FROM increments)
SELECT hourly.time + toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60)) AS time, concat(model) AS series, value FROM (
SELECT time, model, round(sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(time) RANGE BETWEEN 3599 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS value FROM timeline CROSS JOIN labels LEFT JOIN increments USING (time, model)
) AS hourly WHERE hourly.time + toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60)) >= $__fromTime AND hourly.time + toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60)) <= $__toTime AND value > 0 ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Refusals per hour
panels.description: Requests Moira refused (tier_exhausted: no eligible model has quota), per requested name and reason.

targets.rawSql:
WITH increments AS (
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['requested'] AS requested, Attributes['reason'] AS reason, sum(d) AS d FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'moira_refusals_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
) WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY time, requested, reason
), timeline AS (SELECT toStartOfInterval($__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) + toIntervalSecond(number * greatest($__interval_s, 60)) AS time FROM numbers(toUInt64(greatest(dateDiff('second', toStartOfInterval($__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND), $__toTime), 0) / greatest($__interval_s, 60)) + 1)), labels AS (SELECT DISTINCT requested, reason FROM increments)
SELECT hourly.time + toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60)) AS time, concat(requested, ' ', reason) AS series, value FROM (
SELECT time, requested, reason, round(sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY requested, reason ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(time) RANGE BETWEEN 3599 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS value FROM timeline CROSS JOIN labels LEFT JOIN increments USING (time, requested, reason)
) AS hourly WHERE hourly.time + toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60)) >= $__fromTime AND hourly.time + toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 60)) <= $__toTime AND value > 0 ORDER BY time, series
